summary: Fresh tests completed on one physical 7900 XTX and on two 7900 XTX cards: one excluded warmup plus three timed 39-frame generations per arm, with a new isolated server for every generation. Full-request medians are 270.098 s on one card and 146.603 s on two (45.7% shorter on the two-card path). Sampler medians are 30.237/59.749 s. This establishes the measured fresh-server workflow result; loader/storage/noise/source differences limit attribution to GPU count alone. All independent guards and loading-swap-v3 remained. No production promotion or native Radiance run.
